name: facet
description: Ask for a model and Facet does the rest: it builds, checks and serves a model for one task.

interface.shortDescription: Ask for a model for one task; Facet builds it, checks it and keeps it live
interface.longDescription: Describe a narrow, repeated task and Facet's agent builds a model for it on its own, runs plain-language evals on every change, and serves it through an OpenAI-compatible API. You approve each quote before anything runs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make a Facet Model for this classification step and show me what it would cost to make it better
